known_findings.summary: SecurityPolicy is exported/documented as guarding session()/spawn_server(), but active policy state is never consulted by runtime operations; prohibited server options still pass through.
Optional PyYAML imports in _project.py and _workflow.py catch Exception rather than ImportError, so a broken installed dependency can be misreported as not installed.
_session.pyi imports ArtifactsFacade/ModelsFacade with `from _facade import ...` instead of a package-relative import despite py.typed shipping.
RunDemo tests claim side effects are mocked but several call run_demo() with the 10-second default UI sleep, making the nominal unit suite needlessly slow and awkward to run monolithically.
